content.title: Nuvve Holding to allocate 30% of excess cash to Bitcoin purchases
content.summary: Nuvve Holding (NVVE) announced its board of directors has approved the inclusion of Bitcoin as a primary asset in the company’s treasury management program. Nuvve will allocate up to 30% of its excess cash, calculated based on its estimated six-month operating expenses, toward BTC purchases. This BTC allocation will be subject to, among other factors, market conditions and the company’s operational cash requirements, including its planned expansion strategy further into the V2G sector. content.title: Nuvve Holding Acquires Full Ownership of Levo Mobility
content.summary: Nuvve Holding ( (NVVE) ) has issued an announcement. Nuvve Holding Corp. has acquired full ownership of Levo Mobility LLC after purchasing the 49% stake held by Stonepeak and Evolve for a minimal price. This strategic move, finalized on October 15, 2024, positions Nuvve to fully leverage Levo’s potential in the burgeoning electric mobility sector, with all customary agreements in place.
